name: bond-bonliva
description: Bonliva-only companion to bond. Enable it per Bonliva repo (.claude/settings.local.json), not globally. Ships fix-qa (QA feedback rounds), log-plan, publish-timelog, projects (Jira + Clockify time logging), request-review and teams-post (Teams), set-reviewers (Bitbucket reviewer defaults), jira-sync (merged PRs to QA, QA test plans), publish-doc (Outline), and setup-plugin, which installs the Bitbucket, Atlassian, Clockify, Outline and Teams MCP servers into each Bonliva project's local scope. Bundles the port-from-prototype, crashlytics-triage, rn-mobile-build and mongo-migration skills, and a migration-guard hook.
